learningObjectives: Select, filter, and transform tabular data

activities.title: DataFrame Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click the table elements to identify their roles.

content.concept: A Pandas DataFrame organizes tabular data into labeled rows and columns.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: A two-dimensional labeled data structure used to organize tabular data.
A named vertical collection of values representing a feature or variable.
A horizontal record containing values for one observation.
A label used to identify and access rows.
A single value located at the intersection of a row and column.
